name: Carefree JU216B00 RV Awning Vinyl Fabric 21' - Camel Shale Fade With White Weatherguard
description: Is it time to replace your old or worn out awning fabric? Replace it with the Carefree of Colorado's JU216B00 awning vinyl fabric.
